name: Ōmu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōmu town emblem in white and yellow: an outlined hexagon of angular strokes enclosing a yellow five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Ōmu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 November 1923.

features.role: Ōmu town emblem — an outlined hexagon of angular strokes enclosing a yellow five-pointed star
